params.prompt: Vertical 9:16 product film. A large tall portrait smart mirror with a slim brushed-metal bezel on a round metal pedestal stands centre frame, filling about half the frame height, in a seamless studio. Lighting comes ONLY from overhead: three spotlights above snap on one after another and beam down onto the mirror, then hold. There are no lights on or around the mirror frame: no bulbs, no LED strip, no glowing border. The beams light the mirror brightly; a soft highlight sweeps across the clean glass; a pool of light and a reflection on the glossy grey floor; light haze in the beams. The camera slowly orbits and pushes in. No people, no text. Premium, minimal, photoreal, well exposed.
